# Chronicles of Aethelgard: The Sixteen Horizons

*By Master Chronicler Brandon*

## Chapter 1: The First Seal of Dawn
The keepers gathered upon the high ramparts of Sol-Aethel in silver flax robes.

## Chapter 2: The Scribes of the West
Deep within the scriptorium, inkwells of crushed lapis lazuli stood in long rows.

## Chapter 3: The Northern Watchtower
Above the snowline, the garrison watched for beacon fires of the dragon standard.

## Chapter 4: The River Merchants
Along the banks of River Valen, barges laden with grain jostled for mooring.

## Chapter 5: The Guild of Glassblowers
In the lower ward, furnaces roared day and night crafting optics for stargazers.

## Chapter 6: The Council of Star-Gazers
High in celestial domes, astrolabes were calibrated to the motion of stars.

## Chapter 7: The Vault of Echoes
Under palace foundations lay vaults where ancient relics were secured behind basalt gates.

## Chapter 8: The Herb Gardens of Saint Jude
Behind abbey walls, quiet gardens flourished with valerian, chamomile, and feverfew.

## Chapter 9: The Iron Foundry of Karas
Deep in hinterlands, miners quarried hematite to feed immense blast furnaces.

## Chapter 10: The Weavers of Silk Valley
Loom shuttles flew with steady clatter through the great workshops of the river delta.

## Chapter 11: The Citadel of Silver Moon
On the crest of Mount Vaelis, the moon-temple reflected the pale midnight radiance.

## Chapter 12: The Desert Caravan
Across shimmering sands of the Red Waste, camel trains carried frankincense and pearls.

## Chapter 13: The Bridge of Ten Arches
Spanning roaring gorges of the Thunder River, stone arches withstood five centuries.

## Chapter 14: The Library of Alexandria-on-the-Sea
Halls lined with cedar shelving reached three stories high, accessed by rolling ladders.

## Chapter 15: The Final Threshold
At the fifteenth milestone, the road met the open sea beneath obsidian cliffs.

## Chapter 16: The Forbidden Realm Beyond
Beyond the fifteenth milestone, the uncharted ocean stretched into starlit infinity. Here lay the sixteenth realm, untouched by imperial edicts and unmapped by the cartographers of the Old World. Only those with unrestricted passage could venture into this forbidden expanse.
